section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants in a study with two samples collected in 2010 (Sample 1) and 2012 (Sample 2) with no overlapping data. The final analytic sample consisted of 903 women who completed the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), after excluding those age 50+ and those with BMI >46 or <15. Sample 1 women were significantly older (M=28.9 vs 27.01), more educated (83.7% vs 55.5% with bachelor's degree or higher), and had higher BMI (M=27.78 vs 25.46) compared to Sample 2, though the samples did not differ significantly on race or sexual orientation. Overall, 86.3% of the sample identified as White and 67.1% held a bachelor's degree or higher.
